item.title: Oro okays fuel-based motorela fares matrix
item.description: The Cagayan de Oro City Council approves a new fuel-based fare matrix for motorelas to balance the needs of commuters and drivers amid rising pump prices.

item.title: FEIHE Introduces Halal-Certified Fresh Milk Formula, A Game-Changing Offering for Zamboanga Families
item.description: FEIHE introduces Halal-certified AceKid Activegro and Optigrow in Zamboanga. Discover how this fresh milk formula meets rigorous standards for quality, safety, and local family values.

item.title: Essential vs non-essential
item.description: Netnet Camomot explores the shifting definition of "essentials" in Cagayan de Oro amidst rising fuel prices, political dynasties, and the nostalgia of People Power.

item.title: Of poets and poetry
item.description: Raul G. Moldez reflects on World Poetry Day, the defense of the "highest literary form," and the quiet discipline of legislating the world through verse.

item.title: Tomorrow’s Price, Today’s Bill
item.description: An insightful look into the "replacement cost" system of fuel pricing in the Philippines. Why do consumers pay tomorrow’s prices today while rollbacks take their time?

item.title: International Women’s Month Feature: Mindanaoan Seafarer KC Chin-Sood Navigates a Male-Dominated Maritime Industry
item.description: Discover the inspiring story of Second Officer KC Abigail Chin-Sood, a Mindanaoan woman breaking barriers in the maritime industry after 12 years at sea.
